palette.primary_role: Page background, header bg (deep dark with subtle purple-blue undertone for cyber feel)
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons (neon red/cyan), key highlights, active states, rank badges, tournament callouts
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (dark with slight color tint), section alternation, modal backgrounds
palette.neutral_role: Body text (light gray on dark bg), secondary info, muted elements, game stats
palette.border_role: Card borders, input borders (subtle colored tint for sci-fi feel), dividers with glow

button_styles.text: action-oriented (Play Now, Download, Join Tournament, Get Started, Buy Now)
Watch Trailer, Learn More, View Champions, Explore

elevation.approach: Colored glow shadows (neon box-shadow in accent colors) rather than traditional neutral drop shadows. Cards have subtle inner glow borders.

typical_order: header (dark bg, logo left, nav center with hover glow effects, CTA right, optional top banner for tournament/livestream)
hero (full-width game cinematic or trailer video bg + game title + subtitle + primary CTA + platform icons + ESRB rating)
features (dark cards with neon icon borders: gameplay mechanics, modes, weapons, maps — bento grid or 3-column)
characters / champions (character cards: portrait + name + role + ability icons + lore snippet — grid or horizontal scroll)
gallery (full-bleed screenshot grid with lightbox, video embeds, concept art — masonry or carousel)
tournaments / esports (upcoming events: date + prize pool + teams + 'Register' button, leaderboard widget)
download_cta (centered, dark bg with neon glow, platform buttons: Steam/Epic/Xbox/PlayStation/App Store icons)
footer (4-column: game info, community links, support, legal + age rating + platform icons + social)
hero_variants: cinematic_trailer (Riot Games style — full-bleed video, game logo centered, 'Play Free' CTA, dark overlay)
countdown_launch (pre-release — dark bg, game title, countdown timer, wishlist CTA, platform icons)
character_showcase (fighting game style — character lineup with animated hover, 'Choose Your Fighter' feel)
livestream_embed (community/platform style — embedded Twitch/YouTube player, chat sidebar, schedule)
feature_card_variants: gameplay_card (icon + feature name + description, neon border accent on hover, dark glass bg)
character_card (full character art + name + role class + 3 ability icons, overlay on hover with lore)
tournament_card (game logo + date + prize pool + registered teams count + region flag + 'Join' CTA)
weapon_gear_card (item render + name + stats bars (damage/speed/range) + rarity indicator color)

tone_profile.headline_style: short, explosive, under 5 words (e.g., 'Enter the Arena.', 'Legends Rise.', 'Dominate.')
tone_profile.cta_style: imperative, urgent (Play Now, Download Free, Join the Fight, Compete, Claim Your Rank, Get the Game)

color_mood: neon_crimson (Razer/Cyberpunk: #0a0a0f bg, #ff0044 neon red, #00ff88 green highlight — aggressive gaming)
arcane_purple (Riot/League: #0d0d1a bg, #bf40bf purple, #ffd700 gold accent — fantasy/moba feel)
cyber_teal (Cyberpunk/sci-fi: #12121a bg, #00d4ff cyan, #ff073a red accent, #f0f0f0 text — futuristic)
toxic_green (esports/competitive: #0a0f0a dark green-black, #39ff14 neon green, #000000 — arena energy)
ember_orange (Blizzard/Overwatch: #1a1220 dark, #ff6600 orange, #ffcc00 yellow — warm action, heroic)
typography_mood: orbitron_futuristic (Orbitron headings, Exo 2 body — sci-fi, cyberpunk, space/racing games)
rajdhani_sharp (Rajdhani headings and body — sharp, competitive, esports, fps games)
russo_impact (Russo One headings, Inter body — bold, comic-style, character-driven games)
layout_density: cinematic_spacious (AAA game studio: full-bleed videos, large sections, immersive storytelling)
esports_dashboard (tournament-focused: scores, brackets, streams, leaderboards — dense information)
community_grid (community/platform: user-generated content, forum cards, activity feeds)

game_detail_page.best_practices: Persistent purchase/download CTA, system requirements toggle, screenshot gallery with lightbox, trailer embed prominent
